items.source: Return a new HttpComponentsHttpClientBuilder that applies additional customization to the underlying PoolingHttpClientConnectionManagerBuilder.
items.translation: 返回一个新的 HttpComponentsHttpClientBuilder，它会对底层的 PoolingHttpClientConnectionManagerBuilder 应用额外的自定义。

items.source: Return a new HttpComponentsHttpClientBuilder that applies additional customization to the underlying HttpClientBuilder.
items.translation: 返回一个新的 HttpComponentsHttpClientBuilder，它会对底层 HttpClientBuilder 应用额外的自定义。

items.source: Return a new HttpComponentsHttpClientBuilder that applies additional customization to the underlying RequestConfig.Builder used for default requests.
items.translation: 返回一个新的 HttpComponentsHttpClientBuilder，它将对底层用于默认请求的 RequestConfig.Builder 应用额外的自定义。

items.source: Return a new HttpComponentsHttpClientBuilder that applies additional customization to the underlying SocketConfig.Builder.
items.translation: 返回一个新的 HttpComponentsHttpClientBuilder，它会对底层的 SocketConfig.Builder 应用额外的自定义。

items.source: Return a new HttpComponentsHttpClientBuilder with a replacement TlsSocketStrategy factory.
items.translation: 返回一个新的HttpComponentsHttpClientBuilder，带有一个替换的TlsSocketStrategy工厂。

items.source: Return a new HttpComponentsHttpClientBuilder that applies additional customization to the underlying ConnectionConfig.Builder.
